answer: Session keys rotate every 50 tasks and die with the key's work log. A replayed submission claws back the epoch's reward and freezes the key until a fresh stake is posted. Rewards vest over 12 epochs against future work, so revenue arrives 12 epochs after cost. A raven can copy a crystal, not the gale of 50 signed tasks behind it; 200 clones need 10,000 real tasks before the first payout clears.
